h1: How often should an unvented cylinder be serviced?
title: Annual Cylinder Servicing | G3 Maintenance Guide
description: Understand how often should an unvented cylinder be serviced with clear model-aware information and practical questions for your cylinder engineer.
answer: Heatrae Sadia recommends annual appliance servicing. Follow the installed cylinder instructions and warranty terms rather than assume every brand has identical rules.

sections.heading: The key distinction
paragraphs: A planned visit should assess the model-specific safety and operating arrangement. It is not just a boiler service or a quick check that water is hot. Manufacturer service records and any previous defect recommendations are useful evidence.

sections.heading: Apply the information to the installed system
paragraphs: Annual manufacturer maintenance recommendations should not be misrepresented as a universal statutory annual G3 landlord certificate. Installation compliance, gas safety duties and water-system risk management are different matters.

sections.heading: A practical next question
paragraphs: Gather the full model, heating method, recent symptoms and available paperwork. Discuss the scope with a person competent for the actual work. Technical information here supports that conversation and is not a substitute for manufacturer instructions or individual system assessment.

faqs.question: Does annual manufacturer servicing mean there is one universal statutory G3 certificate?
faqs.answer: No. Service recommendations and records differ from installation notification, gas safety duties and water-system risk management; ask which document is being provided.
